title: Applying a Formative Assessment Model for a Blended Learning Environment to Promote Students’ Engagement and Motivation
reason: Quasi-experimental comparison (propensity-matched) of an online formative-assessment model in Moodle versus a traditional model on end-of-course self-reported motivation and engagement. Only group contrasts of self-report; no platform-recorded indicator is analysed.

extraction.country: Vietnam (Vietnam National University, Hanoi; author affiliation)
extraction.n_quote: A total of 271 participants were divided into
extraction.population: university students in blended courses, 1 university (78 per group after matching)
extraction.lms_indicators: none analysed (Moodle used for formative-assessment activities)
extraction.notes: Treatment effect sizes 0.56 (motivation) and 0.38 (engagement) are group contrasts. Analysed n = 156 after matching.
